To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the immature male flower of banana can be used as explant to induce callus,bud,root,and the callus can be used to induce embryo and plantlet.
the best way to induce the callus was that the immature flower buds were sliced into 1.2-1.4 mm thick sections within 24 hours,without surface disinfection.

(1) the immature male flower of banana was an excellent explant for tissue culture and plantlet regeneration; (2) TDZ was an excellent plant growth regulator for callus induction; (3) 6BA was an excellent plant regulator for plantlet regeneration; and (4) IBA was an excellent regulator for root differentiation.
